description_en: Calls the ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion operation to switch the default version of a launch template by specifying the DefaultVersionNumber parameter. If you do not specify a template version number when you create an instance by calling the RunInstances operation, the default version is used
description_zh: 调用ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion接口，并通过指定DefaultVersionNumber参数，切换启动模板的默认版本。如果您在创建实例（RunInstances）时不指定模板版本号，则会采用默认版本
name: ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the launch template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 模板所属的地域ID。您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html 查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the launch template. You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template
parameters.help_zh: 启动模板ID。您必须指定LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName以确定模板。
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the launch template. You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template
parameters.help_zh: 启动模板名称。您必须指定LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName以确定模板。
parameters.name: launch_template_name

parameters.help_en: The version number of the launch template to be set as the default version
parameters.help_zh: 设置为默认版本的启动模板版本号
parameters.name: default_version_number

LaunchTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the launch template. For more information, see [DescribeLaunchTemplates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html）
